title: SolveGeneralizedAlpha: the generalized-alpha solver in Python on SymbolicSystemBase
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.51.3 (decided: a generalized-alpha solver in Python with the settings of SimulationSettings, checked against the internal solver): exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SolveGeneralizedAlpha, the algorithm of MainSolverImplicitSecondOrder (Arnold and Bruls) with Newton's method on ResidualJacobian, the settings of timeIntegration, the output through mbs.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SolveGeneralizedAlpha(system, simulationSettings): the generalized-alpha and Newmark methods of MainSolverImplicitSecondOrder in Python, with constant step size, Newton's method on the exact Jacobian of the residual, the settings of timeIntegration and the output through mbs. symbolicGeneralizedAlphaTest.py: equal to SolveDynamic to 1e-10.
